summary: Additive local file-first source reading through the existing native reader; v1 record reading is unchanged.

interface.addressing: The snapshot_id plus path already emitted by Brief/agent query navigation/inspect is the locator. No new discovery token. A path must resolve to exactly one scanned source_fact_sources binding in this admitted snapshot. Membership is not proof that a particular caller performed discovery and is not authentication.
interface.selection: 1-4 file selections, duplicate positions retained, no mixed record IDs, arbitrary paths, raw line ranges, roots or source scan. Use v1 record reading for a large file.
interface.compatibility: No generator change: persisted rows, extraction, ranking and snapshot format are unchanged. No requirement to rebuild a publication solely for this additive reader.

safety.currentness: Mandatory exact current snapshot verification before and after materialization under existing publication ownership.
safety.source: Shared no-follow descriptor reader; whole source content hash and stable metadata; regular files only. Reject unindexed/excluded/not-scanned paths before materialization. All selected files must be admitted before any result is emitted.
safety.secrets: Scan the entire selected file, including content outside indexed declaration ranges and suppression comments. Redact whole file with text=null; never return a clipped body.
safety.sizes: Existing 128 KiB request/output, 1 MiB per source, 4 MiB materialization, 32 KiB serialized evidence. Explicit whole-file omissions, including JSON escaping cost, not clipping.
safety.result: evidence.files and evidence.bodies/omissions retain request indices, paths, physical ranges and source content hashes. Complete means all selected files delivered unredacted, never answer completeness, authentication or execution.

negativeCases: v1 file selector / v2 record selector / mixed fields / duplicate JSON keys
empty or >4 selections / non-string / control / noncanonical / absolute / traversal paths
unknown, document-only, skipped or excluded source binding
wrong snapshot / stale source / changed publication / symlink / special file / concurrent mutation
secret outside indexed declaration / late secret / suppression comment
source-file size / serialized evidence size / escaped byte cost / no partial output
boundary: Native Core and private source-owned client only. No Server endpoint, installed client, Stable change, model or new parser.
